name: buzz-omnigent-acp
description: A minimal ACP bridge from Buzz mentions to self-hosted Omnigent sandbox sessions.

scripts.demo: node -e "throw new Error('The mock browser demo is retired. Use npm run platform:up for the real Buzz + Omnigent platform.')"
scripts.agents:gemini: npm run build && node dist/src/platform/render-agents.js gemini .local/agents
scripts.agents:copilot: npm run build && node dist/src/platform/render-agents.js copilot .local/agents
